title: Zephyrine and the Ledger
author: Ivo Yarrow
blurb: Ada Delacroix, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
